title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator

Location: Wymondham, Norfolk
Salary: £13.91 per hour
Contract: Temporary, up to 12 weeks
Start Date: ASAP
Hours: Full time, Monday Friday
Working Arrangement: On-site, hybrid minimum 3 days per week

We are currently recruiting for an Accounts Administrator to join the Finance team of a prestigious high-performance manufacturer based near Wymondham, Norfolk.

This is an exciting opportunity to work within a fast-paced manufacturing environment, supporting the Finance team with a range of accounts payable and general administration duties.

Key Responsibilities
- Accurately process supplier invoices within agreed timescales
- Process invoices and assist with VAT administration
- Complete financial data entry and maintain accurate records
- Investigate and resolve supplier queries
- Reconcile supplier statements against ledger balances
- Liaise with internal teams to resolve invoice queries and approval issues
- Manage supplier debit notes and cancellations
- Prepare supplier payment runs and post transactions to the cash book
- Carry out reconciliations and error checks on control accounts and intercompany balances
- Maintain accurate information within the finance system
- Distribute and file supplier correspondence and documentation
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and support relevant teams with training

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have previous Accounts Payable experience, although this is not essential. We're looking for someone who is:
- Organised, proactive and able to take ownership of their work
- Confident working independently and as part of a team
- A strong communicator with a professional, customer-focused approach
- Comfortable working with data and financial information
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Educated to GCSE Grade C or above (or equivalent) in Maths and English

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you looking for your next step up within practice, with the opportunity to develop your skills, progress your career, continue studying and work alongside a brilliant team?

NXTGEN are working with a fantastic accountancy practice on the outskirts of Wymondham who are looking for an Accounts Assistant to join their supportive team. Having worked closely with this client for several years, I know they offer a great environment for someone who wants to build on their existing experience, take on more responsibility and progress their career.

You'll be joining a friendly and supportive team, working with a varied portfolio of local SME clients and gaining exposure to a range of year-end accounts, management accounts, tax and VAT work. You'll have the opportunity to build strong relationships with your clients, become their main point of contact and support them with their day-to-day accounting needs, all while continuing to develop your technical knowledge and experience alongside your studies.

Key Responsibilities:
- Preparing year-end accounts for a varied portfolio of local SME clients.
- Assisting with tax returns, VAT returns and other accounting requirements.
- Preparing management accounts.
- Building relationships with clients and acting as a key point of contact for any queries.
- Supporting clients with their day-to-day accounting needs.
- Working closely with the wider team to continue building on your existing knowledge and experience.
- Working across a range of accounting software, including QuickBooks, Sage and Xero.

What's in it for you?
- A genuinely supportive firm that will invest in your studies, personal development and career progression.
- A clear progression pathway, tailored to your own career goals and aspirations.
- Study support and guidance to help you balance your qualifications alongside your day-to-day workload.
- Exposure to a varied portfolio of local SME clients, giving you the opportunity to broaden your experience across accounts, tax and VAT.
- The opportunity to attend networking events and business breakfasts if you'd like to develop your professional network.
- The chance to make a genuine impact within a smaller firm, where you can build strong relationships with both your clients and colleagues.
- A relaxed and friendly working environment where you'll be supported to develop and progress.
- Flexibility and hybrid working.

This is a great opportunity for someone who already has some experience within practice and is looking for their next step, whether that's broadening their accounts experience, gaining more exposure to management accounts and client work, or continuing to work towards their professional qualifications with a firm that will support them along the way.

There's lots more to the role, so if you're looking for an opportunity where you can develop your skills, continue studying and progress your career as part of a brilliant team, I'd love to hear from you!

Get in touch with Annie at NXTGEN Recruitment to find out more

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Berry Recruitment are looking for a Bookkeeper to join a successful and growing company in Fakenham.

You will take responsibility for the day-to-day financial administration of the business, ensuring accurate record-keeping, effective financial controls, and timely reporting. The successful candidate will work closely with management, colleagues, and external accountants while also providing general office administration support where required.

Main responsibilities will include:

Managing and maintaining accurate financial records using accounting software.

Processing accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions efficiently and accurately.

Managing customer account queries and resolve payment disputes.

Raising delivery notes and sales invoices.

Ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations, policies, and procedures.

Providing administrative support to management and the wider team.

To be considered for this role, you must have:

Experience in a bookkeeping role.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping principles and financial processes.

Experience managing accounts payable and accounts receivable functions.

Proficiency in accounting software such as Xero, Sage, or QuickBooks, and strong IT skills.

Excellent organisational, communication and time management skills.

Ability to work independently, prioritise workloads, and meet deadlines.

Both full time and part time hours available.

Rate of pay starting at 13.00 to 14.00 per hour, depending on experience.

This is a permanent position.

For further information, please contact Lauren or Jade at Berry Recruitment, King's Lynn.

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

title: Client Bookkeeper
description:
Client Bookkeeper

Norwich £28,000 to £34,000 Full-time, permanent Hybrid after probation

If you're the bookkeeper people come to when something doesn't add up, and you'd rather build smarter ways of working than do things the way they've always been done, read on.

This is a bookkeeping and client-focused role with a modern Norwich practice. You'll keep the bookkeeping running smoothly, review other people's work and produce VAT, MTD and possibly management accounts, with AI tools to help you work faster.

THE FIRM

An independent, cloud-based accountancy practice in Norwich with a clear purpose: to make accounting a genuine partnership for small businesses, not a black box. The client base is varied and interesting, from owner-managed businesses and entrepreneurs to charities and social enterprises.

They use AI tools properly (with a human always checking the output), the leadership team are serious about training and technical standards, and the culture puts wellbeing and development front and centre.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Running the day-to-day bookkeeping and reporting planner, so work flows and deadlines are hit
- Reviewing junior colleagues' bookkeeping, spotting patterns and training errors out rather than quietly fixing them
- Preparing and submitting VAT and MTD returns
- Processing and reviewing bookkeeping in Dext, FreeAgent, Xero and QuickBooks
- Using AI to speed up file reviews, draft client queries and pull insight from the numbers
- Spotting bottlenecks and clearing them, rather than letting queries sit

WHO THIS WILL SUIT
- AAT or ICB qualified (MICB or FICB), or strong QBE
- At least 3 years' multi-client experience in UK accountancy practice
- Confident with VAT, MTD and management accounts
- Genuinely tech-savvy and keen on AI and automation
- Unafraid of change and happy to rethink how things are done
- Someone who drives work forward and enjoys helping others improve

WHAT'S ON OFFER
- £28,000 to £34,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working once you've passed probation
- Fully funded private healthcare, an Employee Assistance Programme and trained Mental Health First Aiders
- Profit-share bonus and pension
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Support with further study if you want to progress
- A green, easy-to-reach office with a cycle to work scheme

INTERESTED?

Give me a call or send your CV for a confidential chat. Nothing goes to the firm without your say-so.

Know someone who'd be perfect for this? If I place them, I'll send you £250 in John Lewis vouchers as a thank you.

title: Credit Controller

Credit Controller

Location: Norwich, Norfolk
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000
Contract: Permanent Full-time

The Opportunity

Keeler Recruitment is delighted to be supporting a growing and forward-thinking business in the Norwich area with the recruitment of an experienced Credit Controller.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a confident and proactive finance professional who enjoys building relationships, managing customer accounts and playing a key role in maintaining healthy cash flow.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding payments.

- Previous experience working in a Credit Control or Accounts Receivable role.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
NXTGEN are delighted to be working exclusively with a well-established, family-run business based south of Norwich, who are looking to recruit a Finance Assistant on a permanent basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a close-knit finance team within a successful, growing business with a strong reputation for quality and service. The company prides itself on delivering exceptional products to customers across the UK and internationally, offering a welcoming working environment where attention to detail, teamwork and a hands-on approach are valued.

Working within a busy finance function, you will support the day-to-day running of the accounts department, taking responsibility for a varied range of transactional finance duties and supporting the wider team with accurate financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing both the purchase ledger and sales ledger.
- Processing sales invoices and ensuring transactions are recorded accurately.
- Completing bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Preparing and reconciling debtor and creditor statements.
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of VAT returns.
- Processing payments in multiple currencies.
- Supporting month-end processes and preparing relevant financial reports.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring all transactions are processed in a timely manner.
- Providing general support to the finance team as required.

About You:

We are looking for someone with previous experience in a similar finance or accounts administration role, with a good understanding of purchase ledger and sales ledger processes. You will have strong numerical skills, excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work, ensuring accuracy across all aspects of the role.

Experience using Sage Line 50 would be highly beneficial, alongside good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. You will also be organised, proactive and confident communicating with colleagues at all levels. The ability to use your own initiative, manage competing priorities and bring a positive, can-do attitude to a busy team will be key to your success.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
NXTGEN is recruiting a part-time Finance Assistant for a long-established business with a loyal customer base and a strong reputation for personal service. Now part of a successful wider group, the business has retained the close-knit feel and longstanding relationships that have shaped its success.

As Finance Assistant, you will work closely with the finance team, you'll support the day-to-day running of the accounts function, with a particular focus on sales invoicing, collecting payments and processing purchase invoices. You'll have regular contact with customers and colleagues, giving you a good understanding of the business and how your work supports it.

This is a varied Finance Assistant position for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, keeping things organised and seeing queries through to a resolution. Alongside your finance duties, you'll help with wider administration and provide support across the team.

title: Management Accounts Assistant
description:
Join Newsquest, one of the UK's largest and most successful local media organisations, reaching millions of readers every month through our trusted newspapers, websites and digital marketing solutions. As part of our Finance team, you'll play a key role in supporting the delivery of accurate financial reporting, forecasting and analysis that helps drive business performance across the organisation.

Reporting to the Financial Controller and working within a wider finance function, you'll assist in the production of management information, provide valuable insight into financial performance, and support operational managers in achieving business objectives while maintaining robust financial controls.

This is a hybrid role, with travel to our Norwich office as and when required. We also have offices in Basildon, Colchester and Ipswich, which may provide additional flexibility depending on your location and business requirements. In addition, we have a Central London office in Holborn, where occasional team or business meetings may be held, requiring infrequent travel as needed.

This opportunity would suit an ambitious finance professional who enjoys working collaboratively, analysing financial data, influencing decision-making and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within a dynamic and evolving business.

Key Responsibilities

Management Accounting & Reporting
- Prepare and post month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and cost reallocations.
- Support the production of monthly management accounts and associated commentary.
- Prepare reporting packs and key performance indicators for management review.
- Complete detailed variance analysis against budget, forecast and prior year performance.
- Assist with year-end schedules, reconciliations and audit requirements.

Forecasting, Budgeting & Analysis
- Prepare weekly profit forecasts using submissions from Commercial Directors and operational teams.
- Review financial submissions, challenge assumptions where appropriate and investigate variances.
- Support the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts.
- Maintain forecasting and budgeting models.
- Analyse trends and provide meaningful insight into financial and operational performance.
- Assist budget holders with forecasting, planning and cost management activities.

Business Partnering & Commercial Support
- Build strong relationships with managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Support operational teams by providing timely and accurate financial information.
- Develop a detailed understanding of departmental and operational cost drivers.
- Monitor costs and identify unusual movements, trends and opportunities for improvement.
- Produce regular and ad hoc reporting to support business decision-making.

Controls, Compliance & Governance
- Ensure financial records are maintained in line with company policies and accounting standards.
- Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, resolving outstanding items promptly.
- Support internal and external audit requirements.
- Help maintain strong financial controls and governance processes.
- Identify areas of risk and recommend improvements to controls and procedures.
- Ensure reporting deadlines are consistently achieved with a high degree of accuracy.

Process Improvement & Team Support
- Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, accuracy and automation.
- Support the implementation of new systems and reporting tools.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the finance function.
- Assist in the development of standard operating procedures and process documentation.
- Provide support to colleagues within the wider finance team.
- Undertake ad hoc projects, analysis and reporting as required.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Essential
- Part-qualified (ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) or qualified by experience.
- Previous experience working within a management accounting or assistant accountant role.
- Strong understanding of month-end processes, journals, accruals, prepayments and reconciliations.
- Experience producing management information, financial analysis and reporting.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
- Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large volumes of data.
- Ability to interpret financial information and communicate findings clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Proactive and collaborative approach with excellent communication skills.

Desirable
- Experience working within a multi-site or fast-paced commercial environment.
- Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling.
- Experience supporting audits and maintaining financial controls.
- Exposure to reporting systems and finance automation projects.
- Experience using ERP or finance systems such as Oracle, SAP, NetSuite or similar.

Personal Attributes
- Commercially aware and driven to understand business performance.
- Curious, inquisitive and confident challenging assumptions.
- Adaptable and comfortable working in a changing environment.
- Team-oriented with a positive and professional attitude.
- Committed to continuous learning and personal development.

If you're looking to develop your finance career within a well-established, forward-thinking media business where your work will directly influence decision-making and performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays + your birthday off
- Holiday buy scheme for extra flexibility
- Structured career progression & ongoing training
- Pension plan
- Employee Helpline counselling and advice
- Perks & discounts including:
- Gym membership

- Retail discounts
- Team building days & annual volunteer charity day
